reference_sql:
WITH month_ends AS (
  -- one row per month end of 2024 and 2025 (fx_rates holds every day)
  SELECT MAX(rate_date) AS month_end
  FROM fx_rates
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', rate_date)
), mrr AS (
  -- one row per month end
  SELECT m.month_end, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS mrr_eur
  FROM month_ends m
  JOIN subscription_events e ON e.event_date <= m.month_end
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  WHERE s.currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY m.month_end
)
SELECT m.month_end, m.mrr_eur, p.mrr_eur AS mrr_prev_year_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (m.mrr_eur - p.mrr_eur) / p.mrr_eur, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM mrr m
JOIN mrr p ON year(p.month_end) = year(m.month_end) - 1 AND month(p.month_end) = month(m.month_end)
WHERE m.month_end >= DATE '2025-01-31'

WITH me AS (
  SELECT MAX(rate_date) AS month_end FROM fx_rates
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', rate_date)
), mrr AS (
  SELECT m.month_end, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS mrr_eur
  FROM me m
  JOIN subscription_events e ON e.event_date <= m.month_end
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  WHERE s.currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY m.month_end
)
SELECT m.month_end, m.mrr_eur, p.mrr_eur AS mrr_prev_year_eur,
  ROUND((m.mrr_eur - p.mrr_eur) * 100.0 / p.mrr_eur, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM mrr m
JOIN mrr p ON year(p.month_end) = year(m.month_end) - 1 AND month(p.month_end) = month(m.month_end)
WHERE m.month_end >= DATE '2025-01-31'
